messages:
Sophia Park: Quick org update — Velocity team leadership/backfill. Effective 2026-04-01 Elena Park will step in as Acting Eng Lead while we run a permanent backfill. We are opening 2x Senior Infra Engineer roles. Details and JD here: <https://redwood.company/docs/velocity-lead-backfill>

Mason Lee: Congrats Elena! :tada:

Elena Park: Thanks everyone. I'll keep project work going but will be dedicating ~60% time to leadership & handovers. Mason — can you shadow weekly triage with me?

Mason Lee: Yep, happy to. Let's sync Mon 10am.

Priya Raman: Heads up — please route hiring questions to people-ops and cc me. We'll prioritize candidates with infra/latency experience and production inference background.

Alex Torres: Congrats Elena. Will nominate an IC to cover on-call rotations. Can someone post an updated org chart?

Sophia Park: Org chart + role JD are in the doc above. High-level hiring timeline: shortlist by 2026-04-10, interviews 2026-04-15 → 2026-04-24, offer decisions by ~2026-05-05.

hire-bot: Requisition created: REQ-2026-458 — Velocity Senior Infra Engineer. Hiring manager: Priya Raman. Recruiter: Nora.

Elena Park: Appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll publish a 2-week transition plan for the team by EOD with who owns what.

Nora (People Ops): Congrats Elena — we'll support interview scheduling. :thumbsup:

Mason Lee: One practical ask — can we pause major infra refactors until the new hires ramp? Avoid too much churn during transition.

Priya Raman: Agreed. Elena, please add that constraint to the transition plan.

Sophia Park: Will follow up in this thread with panel volunteers and interview rubric later today. Thanks all for the quick responses and support.
